title: TABLESTYLE resolved-handle writer handoff
scope: Avoid an unnecessary copy when handing the validated TABLESTYLE source-handle list from the adapter to the DXF writer.
Preserve existing const-reference setter behavior and ASCII/Binary graph output.

sourceChange.before: The adapter passed m_tableStylesToEmit to a const-reference setter, which copied the vector into dxfRW.
sourceChange.after: An additive rvalue overload transfers the vector into dxfRW; fileExport moves the validated list because it has no later adapter reads. The const-reference overload is unchanged.
sourceChange.effect: Removes one full vector copy at the writer setup boundary without changing ownership contracts for existing callers, object layout, or emitted references.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Existing generated owner-graph test exercises resolved TABLESTYLE handles and typed/raw table-style output/readback in ASCII and Binary DXF.

validation.diffCheck: passed for src/libdxfrw.h, dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes one adapter-to-writer TABLESTYLE handle-vector copy. The const-reference API remains available; external qualification and semantic support gates are unchanged.

testsRun: Focused existing SORTENTSTABLE/TABLESTYLE owner-graph round-trip CTest
method.limitations: No allocation instrumentation or process-RSS measurement was performed; this is source-confirmed elimination of one vector copy, not a general memory or performance bound.
